safeHtml:
'''Brighton Hall''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-09.

History

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Brighton Hall. One of them has to do with paying homage to Denith Poon, a former member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other was the fact that the Poon Family, with the help of a Reverend whose family name was Brighton, had built a cathedral that illuminates the night even during fierce snowstorms. The Cathedral was named Brighton Hall, and in order to commemorate the lives that were saved, the hall had become the namesake of this area.

Since this area is located at the geographical center of Asylum, Brighton Hall had become the new City Center of Asylum in the redevelopment, which features administrative offices, including a District Court and a Government Office.

The Developer of this District had plans to built a large-scale interchange beneath the Brighton Hall Intersection, featuring several Bus Termini near the tentative location which could serve up to 28 Bus Lines as its terminus. However, changes in plans had meant that the Station would be moved to near the boundary with Exalt Gardens. With that being said, plans for The BRIGHTON Shopping Mall, and the Topside Development BRIGHTON HOUSE remain unchanged, and citizens who plan to go to the administrative offices only require a walking time of at most 10 minutes with any transport facility.

While this district was originally planned to house a large retail park, the location of the park became Sheung Yam Estate due to changes in plans.

Fun Facts

  • The Color Scheme of this station alludes to Lycoris Recoil, a Japanese Anime released in 2022. Multiple Elements within this station also alludes to this anime as follows:
  • The Chinese Name of this station and the Interchange Corridor of this station alludes to Chisato Nishigiki, one of the main protagonists of this anime.
  • This station began concourse construction on September 23, the birthday of Chisato Nishigiki. However, it did not begin services until six days later.
  • Café LycoReco is set up at the Concourse of this station, providing Blended Coffee, Sencha, Cookie biscuit, Dorayaki, Hot chocolate Parfait and Chisato's "Special Elegant" Parfait.
  • The Station Fountain located at the Center of the Concourse in this station alludes to the same fountain that appeared in Episode 3 of the anime at which the main protagonists hug each other.   • The Platform Walls at both ends are modelled after the two hackers from the animation "Robota" and "Walnut" for Platform 1 and Platform 2, respectively.
  • The Exit Passageways of this station are also based on different characters who appeared in the anime. More information on the character theme and its building materials could be seen at the "Exit Distribution" Section of this page.

However, two years later, on June 11 2021, Gentle Island Pond Station began services near the tracks between and .
